description: Unlike its sibling fts-rest-advanced page (same round, same product area), the Search manage REST API's Security section names only a generic 'Default' HTTP-basic tier with no specific role stated - just 'For more information, see Roles' - even though this is plainly an admin-level cluster-configuration endpoint that would be expected to require the Search Admin role by analogy with the Manage-tier endpoints documented on the sibling page.
